caption: Our one shopper question in the editor preview: Cloze gave the price and stock of The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard ($2,629.95, in stock) within 2 seconds. The generated visitor name and the store name are hidden.
After Sync products the Knowledge tab listed 16 products, while our store has 18. Policies, pages and FAQs stayed at 0. The store name is hidden.
Billing on the Free plan: 25 AI conversations a month with a hard limit, then Starter $49, Pro $99 and Scale $199 a month. Our test used 1 of the 25.
Shopify's approval screen for Cloze Starter: $49 every 30 days plus usage charges of up to $100 per 30 days, with no trial. We did not approve it.
The app page in Shopify lists Enforced IP restrictions as Missing, while access tokens expire every hour. Uninstall app sits under More actions.
